sentences.text: The learned counsel for the Petitioner has submitted that this Writ Petition may be dismissed as withdrawn, with a liberty to move before the Central Administrative Tribunal and also made an endorsement to that effect.

In view of the same, recording the endorsement, this Writ Petition is dismissed, as withdrawn,
with a liberty to the Petitioner to move before the Central Administrative Tribunal.
Consequently, the connected MP is closed.
